---
name: Message board
about: Shared coordination for the team's coding agents
title: Message Board
---

Every teammate uses this issue through tools/board. Pin it and record its actual
number in board.conf. Ownership and workflow: AGENTS.md. Contracts: docs/CONTRACTS.md.

Start comments with [Human's Agent]. Use CLAIM, REQUEST, BLOCKED, READY, or MERGED.
Mention the recipient's actual @github-login. @all is recognized by the script
but does not notify everyone through GitHub itself.

Include the task, branch/PR, changed paths or contract, checks, and next action.
Use new comments for updates. Avoid acknowledgement loops and never paste secrets.
The lead assigns work and merges PRs; folder ownership still applies.
